title: NOMOS Revocation List
description: Response body from GET /.well-known/nomos-revocations (NOMOS-SPEC-006 §4) — a signed, dated aggregation of an issuer's currently-active revocation statements, published for bulk and offline checking. The CRL-equivalent for sealed .nomos artifacts.

generated_at.description: When this list was assembled. Part of the signed payload — the freshness anchor a verifier reasons about when deciding how stale a fetched list is allowed to be (NOMOS-SPEC-006 §9.3).

kid.description: Key id used to sign the list as a whole. Resolvable at /.well-known/nomos-signing-keys.

statements.description: Every currently-active revocation statement known to the issuer, verbatim, in any order. MAY be empty — an empty array is a normal, signed assertion that nothing has been revoked as of generated_at.

signature.description: base64 Ed25519 signature over JCS({ generated_at, statements }) — see NOMOS-SPEC-006 §4.3. Attests completeness and currency of the list as of generated_at, in addition to (not instead of) each statement's own independently-verifiable signature.

statements.reason: Signing key suspected compromised 2026-08-24. All versions sealed under this kid are withdrawn pending re-seal under a rotated key.
